notes:
ONE new record settled: SDN. The other 21 targets were not settled; each is classified below by failure mode.

SETTLED
- SDN (Sudan): the Central Bank of Sudan's own annual report says in Chapter Five that its balance sheet, income statement, statement of changes in owner equity and cash-flow statement 'for the year ended 31st December 2018 as it was audited by the Auditor General Chamber', and the chapter then prints a 'Report of the Independent Auditor-General' addressed to the Board of Directors and signed 'Eltahir Abdelgayoom Ibrahim Malik, Auditor General Of the Republic of Sudan, Khartoum, June 16, 2019'. The same chapter in the 2015 annual report (https://cbos.gov.sd/sites/default/files/Central%20Bank%20of%20Sudan%20Annual%20Report%202015_0.pdf) says the 2015 statements were audited 'by the National Audit Chamber'. So the statutory auditor is the National Audit Chamber of Sudan, headed by the Auditor General; this resolves the judgement call left open by the 2002 Act naming only a statute. The 2018 PDF used as the source sits on cbos01jo2022.dev2.dot.jo, a staging mirror of the bank's own site run by its web developer; the identical statement on the official cbos.gov.sd domain (2015 report, link above) is the fallback if the mirror is distrusted.

STATUTE OR DOCUMENT NAMING ONLY A MECHANISM (no firm, no body - not a record)
- MDG (Madagascar): read Loi n. 2016-004 portant statut de la Banque Centrale in full at https://www.assemblee-nationale.mg/wp-content/uploads/2020/11/Loi-n%C2%B0-2016-004-statut-de-la-Banque-Centrale.pdf. Article 76 creates external audit by an unnamed 'Cabinet d'audit' appointed by the Conseil d'administration; article 85 says the financial statements are audited by that external auditor. The Cour des Comptes appears only at article 7 (the Bank's autonomy cannot be invoked against it) and article 34 (receives a copy of the annual report) - it is never the auditor. Mechanism only.
- VEN (Venezuela): the BCV's own notes to the financial statements at 30 June 2024 (https://bcv.org.ve/system/files/estados_financieros/notas_de_los_estados_financieros_30-06-2024.pdf) name no auditor and no firm. Note 2.2 refers only to 'el informe de los comisarios, segun lo previsto en el articulo 81 ejusdem' - unnamed statutory comisarios. Mechanism only. NOTE: bcv.org.ve fails TLS verification for curl (incomplete certificate chain, curl error 60) even with the proxy CA bundle; it is readable through WebFetch.
- UZB (Uzbekistan): downloaded the CBU Annual Report 2025 in full (https://cbu.uz/upload/medialibrary/b0d/4h8ufsm1pbs5e7dl336ygil61lalyws1/Annual-report-2025.pdf, 4.7 MB, read as text). It contains no auditor's report and no audit firm; the only mentions of KPMG are consultations on unrelated projects. Confirms the earlier finding that article 8 names only a mechanism. The Uzbek Senate lead was not reached.

DOCUMENT PUBLISHED BUT CONTAINS NO EXTERNAL AUDITOR (genuine absence in the document)
- KHM (Cambodia): downloaded the National Bank of Cambodia Annual Report 2022 in full from Open Development Cambodia (https://data.opendevelopmentcambodia.net/km/dataset/6148dd50-c5e8-48a2-b9ca-ff36d2aee86a/resource/df919885-d0f4-4f09-9597-bdb171698176/download/annual-report-2022-eng.pdf). No auditor's report, no audit firm anywhere; the single hit for 'auditor' is a director's CPA/CIA qualification. The NBC annual report is not where its auditor is named. The Khmer-language site and the National Audit Authority leads remain unopened.
- SYR (Syria): cb.gov.sy serves PDFs fine. Downloaded the Central Bank of Syria Annual Report 2019 in full (https://cb.gov.sy/downloads/files/1616663286_Central%20Bank%20of%20Syria%20Business%20Report%20-%20Annual%20Report%202019.pdf) - every one of ~35 audit mentions is internal audit (مديرية التدقيق الداخلي); no external auditor. Also downloaded the seven numbered PDFs that cb.gov.sy returns for Law 23/2002 searches (1697702582, 1675672962, 1675336384, 1689503688, 1690886742, 1699939039, 1698301233) - all are Bank Management Committee decisions (قرار .../ل إ), not the law. Law 23/2002's full Arabic text was NOT found on the site; the lead is still open but needs the site's 'Legislation and regulations - Laws and Decrees' index, whose links are rendered by JavaScript (the /en/publications page yields only one href).
- MWI (Malawi): IMPORTANT CORRECTION - do not file Deloitte. The Scribd copy of 'RBM Financial Statement 31 December 2024' (https://www.scribd.com/document/892367301/RBM-Financial-Statement-31-December-2024) carries a page summary saying the statements were 'audited by Deloitte', but that is a Scribd-generated blurb, not the document's own words; two WebFetch attempts returned only the landing page, not the auditor's report. And the Deloitte connection in Malawian press is a FORENSIC audit, not the annual audit: allafrica (https://allafrica.com/stories/202411290315.html) says 'The Deloitte forensic audit of the Reserve Bank of Malawi (RBM) during Dalitso Kabambe's tenure as governor'. mwnation's report on the 2025 results (https://mwnation.com/rbm-2025-profit-rises-to-k618bn/) names only the audit-committee chair, no firm. HAND CHECK WANTED: open the Scribd document itself and read the signature line of its independent auditor's report.

HOST BLOCKS (confirmed again, do not retry)
- MKD (North Macedonia): the NBRNM's own auditor's-report PDFs ARE indexed and openly published - https://www.nbrm.mk:443/content/Independent-Auditor's-Report-and-Financial-Statement-of-the-National-Bank_2023.pdf and the 2024 Macedonian-language equivalent https://nbrm.mk/content/Извештај-на-независниот-ревизор-и-Финансиски-извештаи-на-НБ_2024.pdf. Both hosts return Cloudflare HTTP 403 to curl (with and without www, browser user-agent, 5981 and 7020-byte challenge pages) and WebFetch returns client_error with nothing retrieved. This is a pure host block on documents that exist: a hand check from a normal browser would settle MKD in one minute. HAND CHECK WANTED on those two URLs.
- CUW (Curacao): exch.centralbank.cw IS reachable via WebFetch (curl fails: 'SSL: no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name'), but the two reachable pages carry no auditor name - the condensed financial statements page for 31 December 2020 (https://exch.centralbank.cw/publications/annual-reports-quarterly-bulletins/2021/condensed-financial-statements-as-of-december-31-2020) names no firm, and the Daily Herald's report on the 2017 statements (https://thedailyherald.sx/islands/cbcs-releases-2017-financial-statements) names none either. The per-year annual-report index pages (https://exch.centralbank.cw/publications/annual-reports-quarterly-bulletins/2017 and .../2018 and .../2024) were NOT opened and are the next step: WebFetch can reach that host.
- RWA (Rwanda): bnr.rw is a JavaScript single-page shell - the legacy path https://www.bnr.rw/index.php?id=82 returns 21 KB whose entire text is 'National Bank of Rwanda You need to enable JavaScript to run this app.' and no document links. The statute route also failed: https://commons.laws.africa/akn/rw/act/po/2017/38/media/publication/rw-act-po-2017-38-publication-document.pdf timed out twice (120 s, zero bytes) - connection problem at laws.africa, worth one retry by hand. A country-name search returns only Rwandan commercial banks.
- EGY, JOR, ARE-adjacent hosts: not retried, per instructions.

NOT REACHED AT ALL (no calls spent, or host unreachable on first contact)
- PSE (Palestine): www.pma.ps/en/Publications/AnnualReports returns a 6 KB Next.js/PostHog shell with no document links; an Arabic-language search for the PMA's independent auditor's report returned nothing from pma.ps. SPA shell, same failure mode as bnr.rw.
- BLR (Belarus): https://www.nbrb.by/engl/publications/report timed out (35 s, zero bytes). A Russian-language search for the NBRB's аудиторское заключение returned only commercial banks. Unsettled; the host may simply be slow and deserves a longer-timeout retry.
- LAO: https://www.bol.gov.la/en/annual_report fails TLS verification (curl error 60, missing issuer); an English search of the Bank of the Lao PDR law for its audit article returned only commercial banks and an unrelated Independent Audit Law on the Lao official gazette.
- PRY (Paraguay): the DNCP procurement route is live but stale. Tender 195638 'CONTRATACION DE AUDITORIA EXTERNA', convocante 'Banco Central del Paraguay (BCP)', state 'Licitacion Adjudicada', total awarded G1,338,776,000 - but it was published 18-02-2011 and the award summary page (https://www.contrataciones.gov.py/licitaciones/adjudicacion/195638-contratacion-auditoria-externa/resumen-adjudicacion.html) does not print the winning supplier; the 'Proveedores Adjudicados' tab was not opened, and in any case 2011 is far from a current mandate. A newer BCP audit tender was not located.
- CPV (Cabo Verde): bcv.cv's SharePoint path returns 404; no Banco de Cabo Verde Relatorio e Contas PDF is indexed anywhere. A promising-looking 'RELATORIO E CONTAS 2020' on the national gazette's own host (https://incv.cv/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/RELATORIO-E-CONTAS-2020.pdf) turns out to be the accounts of INCV-Imprensa Nacional de Cabo Verde, SA itself (audited by AUDITEC - Sociedade de Auditores Certificados, Lda., Praia) - NOT the central bank. The Angolan paper Expansao's report on the BCV's 2022 Relatorio e Contas (https://expansao.co.ao/mundo/africa/detalhe/banco-de-cabo-verde-com-lucros-a-cair-43-e-o-activo-a-crescer-quase-9-60607.html) names no auditor.
- TJK (Tajikistan): a named firm exists but not a current one. Asia-Plus (https://asiaplus.news/en/2019/10/02/tajik-central-bank-proposes-big-4-accounting-firms-to-audit-its-financial-reporting/) reports that 'In 2018, an audit at the National Bank of Tajikistan was conducted by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu (Deloitte)', that earlier annual audits were by 'British Ernst & Young Ford Rhodes Sidat Hyder', and that the NBT then opened a tender restricted to the Big Four for its 2019 reporting, possibly for a five-year contract - but it does not say who won. Filing Deloitte would assert a mandate that may have ended in 2023, so it is left out under the one-current-auditor rule. nbt.tj serves PDFs to curl, so its annual report is a live route.
- DZA, MRT, TKM: no calls spent; untried.

METHOD NOTE for the next round: curl needs no approval and worked on cbos.gov.sd, cb.gov.sy, cbu.uz, incv.cv, contrataciones.gov.py and data.opendevelopmentcambodia.net - including full PDF download plus pdftotext, which is far cheaper than WebFetch. It fails only on Cloudflare (nbrm.mk) and on genuinely broken TLS (bcv.org.ve, bol.gov.la, exch.centralbank.cw), where WebFetch sometimes still succeeds. Pair them: curl first, WebFetch for the TLS-broken hosts.
